title: Mitigating Spectral Bias in Neural Operators for Underwater Transmission Loss Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.18141v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Predicting underwater acoustic transmission loss rapidly and accurately is crucial for real-time ocean acoustic applications. While Fourier Neural Operators (FNO) have emerged as powerful surrogate models due to their global receptive fields, they suffer from spectral bias. The frequency truncation mechanism in FNO filters out high-frequency components, resulting in over-smoothed predictions that fail to capture fine-grained interference patterns. To overcome this limitation, this paper proposes a Spectral-Spatial Residual Learning (S2RL) framework. S2RL decomposes the prediction task into a coarse-to-fine process: a spectral Global Propagator first generates a globally consistent prediction, and a spatial Local Refiner subsequently recovers the high-frequency residuals. Experimental results on a South China Sea dataset show that the proposed method significantly outperforms FNO baselines while maintaining millisecond-level inference s

translated_title: 缓解神经算子在水下传输损失预测中的谱偏差
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18141v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：快速准确地预测水下声学传输损失对于实时海洋声学应用至关重要。尽管傅里叶神经算子（FNO）因其全局感受野而成为强大的替代模型，但它们存在谱偏差问题。FNO中的频率截断机制过滤掉了高频分量，导致预测结果过度平滑，无法捕捉细粒度的干涉模式。为克服这一限制，本文提出了一种谱-空间残差学习（S2RL）框架。S2RL将预测任务分解为一个从粗到细的过程：谱全局传播器首先生成全局一致的预测，随后空间局部细化器恢复高频残差。在南海数据集上的实验结果表明，所提方法显著优于FNO基线，同时保持毫秒级推理速度。
tldr: 本文提出S2RL框架，通过谱全局传播与空间局部细化结合，有效缓解FNO的谱偏差，实现水下传输损失的高精度快速预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an S2RL framework combining spectral global propagation with spatial local refinement to mitigate spectral bias in FNO, enabling accurate and fast underwater transmission loss prediction.
